findings.heading: Rolling by date / Скольжение по дате
findings.proposition: The English sentence carries a working cross-reference to the Time series and outbreak detection page (time_series.qmd); the Russian sentence points at the bare same-page anchor #timeseries_moving, which does not exist in moving_average.ru.qmd.
findings.reader_consequence: A Russian reader who wants the promised slide_dbl() demonstration clicks a link that goes nowhere on the current page, and never reaches the Time series and outbreak detection chapter where the example lives.

findings.heading: Rolling by group / Скользящее по группе
findings.proposition: The English points the reader to the Grouping data page with a link target (grouping.qmd); the Russian gives only the bracketed text [Группирование данных] with no target, so no link is produced.
findings.reader_consequence: A Russian reader is told to see the Grouping data page for the grouping details this section depends on, but gets literal bracketed text instead of a link and must hunt for the chapter by hand.

findings.heading: Calculate with tidyquant within ggplot() / Расчет с помощью tidyquant внутри ggplot()
findings.proposition: The Russian states the daily counts are plotted as a grey line ('в виде серой линии'), while the English says only that the line is faded (alpha < 1) and the chunk beside it sets no colour, only alpha = 0.2 on the default black line.
findings.reader_consequence: A Russian reader looking for the argument that makes the raw-count line grey finds none in the chunk, and may add a colour = "grey" argument that the English example never used.
